title: Multi-cell TABLECONTENT block attribute composition
mode: Runtime-generated ASCII/Binary serializer and adapter qualification

scope.profile: AC1027 2x2 TABLECONTENT grid with one scalar-prefix plus block-content cell carrying one ATTDEF attribute, a second zero-attribute block cell, and two scalar cells.
scope.wireProof: Physical output checks both remapped BLOCK_RECORD group-340 targets; the first block content has group 91 = 1 and ordered group 330 ATTDEF, group 301 text, and group 92 index; the second has group 91 = 0.
scope.typedProof: Fresh readback checks grid dimensions, cell order, scalar-prefix then block-content order, attribute content index, one-based index, text, ATTDEF identity, and BLOCK_RECORD ownership.
scope.fixturePolicy: All drawings are generated at runtime and removed; no persistent DWG/DXF fixture is added.

implementation.summary: Qualified the existing rectangular TABLECONTENT block writer and adapter closure path for an ATTDEF-bearing block cell composed after a scalar value. No production-code change was needed; the focused selector now covers combined grid placement, ordered content, per-content attribute association, exact remapping and fresh readback.
implementation.failureAndRetry: Missing BLOCK_RECORD target, wrong BLOCK owner, missing ATTDEF target, and wrong ATTDEF owner each refuse atomically and preserve a sentinel destination in both encodings. Restoring each source identity/owner permits a corrected export through the same adapter.

limitations: The positive attribute-bearing composition is authored from scratch; it qualifies serializer/readback transport and transaction behavior, not a native producer's semantic use of this composition.
Multiple block CONTENT records within one cell, TABLE block geometry, native rendering, other source versions and whole-document closure remain open.

planImpact.completedScopeRemovedFromQueue: One generated 2x2 grid profile combining a mixed scalar/block cell, one ordered ATTDEF attribute, a second block cell without attributes, exact references, owner refusal, rollback, corrected retry and typed readback.
planImpact.remainingP5BlockCellScope: Multiple block CONTENT records in one cell and source- or consumer-qualified block geometry.
